review.summary: The manuscript correctly presents the designated archived proof, with reproducible numerical evidence and readable typesetting. No mathematical gap or required revision was found. No supplied file was modified.
review.statement_checks: Checked all seven archived contracts against the manuscript, including polynomial hypotheses, real endpoints, quantifiers, constants, error terms and uniformity. Theorem 1.1 preserves P7's conclusions. Corollary 1.2 follows with ε=δ and the stated δ-range. The stronger correlation bound and explicit spectral bounds already occur in the archived proofs. No brief.md was supplied.
review.dependency_checks: Independently checked the density and second-moment identities, uniform correlation truncation, periodic averaging with h-dependent endpoints, Dirichlet-series factorisation, residues and contour estimates. The common coefficient R_f and value D_f(0)=−1/(2ζ(2)) give the required cancellations. The cutoff choices and both cases Y≥Z and Y<Z yield the claimed error budget. The merged lemmas and local completions listed in changes.md are valid; no repair requiring a mathematical decision is needed.
review.numerics_checks: Inspected reproduce.py, both accepted counting sources, reproduction.json and reproduce.log. The pipeline genuinely recomputes counts using the accepted code; archived results enter only the comparison. Acceptance hashes, generated-artifact hashes and PDF hash match. Independently reran the validations and the worker at x=250000: all 24 production rows matched exactly. Regenerated all 21 displayed numerical artifacts in memory from accepted coefficient caches, including Euler products, profiles, fits, uncertainties and plots; every artifact matched. The supplied full-run log reports exact agreement for all 270 rows through x=256000000; I did not independently rerun that entire counting grid. Heuristic uncertainty, extrapolation bias and uncertified floating-point rounding are accurately distinguished.
review.citation_checks: The proof-critical quotations match J. Brüdern, A. Granville, A. Perelli, R. C. Vaughan and T. D. Wooley, On the exponential sum over k-free numbers (1998), https://doi.org/10.1098/rsta.1998.0183, Lemma 2.2; and H. L. Montgomery and R. C. Vaughan, Multiplicative Number Theory I: Classical Theory (2007), https://doi.org/10.1017/CBO9780511618314, Corollaries 10.4–10.5. Checked Vaughan's theorem and constant against R. C. Vaughan, A variance for k-free numbers in arithmetic progressions (2005), https://doi.org/10.1112/S0024611505015352. Background and bibliographic checks used J. Brüdern and T. D. Wooley, Sparse variance for primes in arithmetic progression (2011), https://doi.org/10.1093/qmath/hap029; D. A. Goldston and R. C. Vaughan, On the Montgomery–Hooley asymptotic formula (1997), https://doi.org/10.1017/CBO9780511526091.010; and R. C. Vaughan, On a variance associated with the distribution of general sequences in arithmetic progressions. I (1998), https://doi.org/10.1098/rsta.1998.0185. Other background references were checked against supplied reference lists or candidate records; unavailable originals and unverified DOIs remain explicitly disclosed. No online search or ineligible literature was used.
review.provenance_checks: Appendix B agrees with provenance.json on repository, archive commit, harness commit, model-record revision, model identifiers and CLI versions. Model weight versions are correctly left unknown. Archived statement text matches the selected plan; review contract identifiers match provenance, and every proof hash matches both archived reviews. The manuscript separates archived mathematics from write-up additions and claims no human authorship. No excluded work, other run or online repository content was accessed.
review.layout_checks: Used Poppler text extraction across the complete 47-page PDF and visually inspected rendered theorem, averaging, Dirichlet-series, contour, assembly, numerical-table, plot, appendix and bibliography pages. Equations, indices, references, table headings and plot legends are legible, with no clipping or unresolved references found. The PDF includes all chapters, both appendices and the bibliography.
